title: Kora
text: I've found Kora on the telescope, the moon Engram talks to us from. There's an array on it the size of a county, and it faces us. Not Verdance, not Rime: us. I went back through the old plates. It turned to face Home the night we landed. Not the night after.
notes: STORY.md §13: Kora, Engram's listening array (radio only).
